Klasse Session

java.lang.Object
de.hitec.nhplus.model.Session
public class Session extends Object
Holds the currently logged-in user for the whole application.

This is a simple, process-wide session store implemented with static state, so that any part of the application (for example the LogService) can find out who is acting without having to pass the User through every method call.

Single responsibility: it only stores and exposes the active user; it does not perform authentication itself.
